_comment: Generated by python -m walkers.experiments. MuJoCo, 1 ms step, control every 5 ms.
status: Simulation only. Neither walker has been assembled or powered.

model.closed_loop: connect constraint at the front crank tip plus a joint constraint for the gear train, per side

forward.steady_means: no fall, tilt under 3 degrees, heading change under 5 degrees in 10 s, a foot always down

step_start.what: from rest to 60 rpm with no ramp

stop_mid_stance.what: walk at 60 rpm, command zero speed at 3.0 s and hold

stop_at_handover.what: walk at 60 rpm, command zero speed at 3.25 s and hold

slopes.note: Slope by tilting gravity. Walks means: no fall, tilt under 15 degrees from the slope, and at least half the ideal distance. Friction 0.4.

steps.note: A square step across the path, 140 mm ahead of the axle row. The feet lift 24 mm at most.

phase_errors.tolerated_means: no fall, at least 90 percent of the speed with no error, tilt under 3 degrees

verdict.walks: At 60 rpm it walks 46.7 mm/s in a straight line with 0.2 percent slip, tilt under 0.3 degrees. Peak motor torque 0.285 N m of 0.4 N m stall; mean 0.038 N m.
verdict.speed: Steady up to 90 rpm (70.4 mm/s). At the motor's 165 rpm: 32.6 mm/s, tilt up to 10.25 degrees, heading change -15.3 degrees, no foot on the floor 6 percent of the time.
verdict.turning: right side at 45 rpm: heading 0.1 degrees in 12 s; right side at 30 rpm: heading -0.5 degrees in 12 s; right side at 0 rpm: heading 2.2 degrees in 12 s; right side at -60 rpm: heading -0.3 degrees in 12 s.
verdict.slope: Steepest walked: 6 degrees up, 12 down, 4 with the left side high, 2 with the right side high.
verdict.phase: Phase error between the sides tolerated: 45 degrees.
